description: Retrieve the wallet's recent on-chain transaction history from event logs. Shows executions, queued transactions, approvals, cancellations, spend policy updates, and operator changes. Filter by event type or block range for targeted queries.

from_block.description: Start block (decimal string). Defaults to 1000 blocks ago.

to_block.description: End block (decimal string). Defaults to latest.

name: get_transaction_history
